concurrency_test: Paused catalog commit permits reads of the affected and unrelated inodes and native writes to another inode; conflicting mutations wait; release/forget pins survive through reply capture.
durability: Manifest and live binding commit atomically in one FULL transaction before native retirement. Timestamp sync policy and inode gates are unchanged.
atomic_seal_test: Binding failure rolls back manifest and chunks; process death after manifest insertion but before binding/commit preserves native bytes with an empty catalog; post-commit recovery still reconstructs exact bytes.
